title: The Central Valley: between the Andes and the Coastal Range
goal: Describe the Central Valley of Chile, its climate and Santiago, putting the important idea first.
grammar: emphatic fronting and word order inversion

items: I can put a place, a time or a quality first to stress it when I describe the Central Valley.
I can say where most Chileans live and what the climate is like.
I can name the main words for the mountains, the valley and the vineyards in Spanish.
